name: What is the typical warranty for a new garage door installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical warranty for a new garage door installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranties for new garage door installations typically cover both the door itself and the installation labor, though terms vary by manufacturer and contractor. Manufacturer warranties for doors often range from 1 to 10 years, covering defects in materials and workmanship. Components like springs and hardware might have shorter warranties. Labor warranties from the contractor usually last for a shorter period, often 1 to 3 years, covering installation-related issues. Always clarify specific warranty details before proceeding with an upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: Warranties vary, typically covering door materials (1-10 years) and installation labor (1-3 years). Always confirm specifics.
